description:
Signing keys off the heap: JWTs signed and checked with an HMAC key
    (HS256/384/512), signed with an RSA or EC private key (RS, PS, ES) held by
    OpenSSL, and webhook signatures (GitHub, Stripe, any HMAC) checked - the
    key read from a secret provider into native memory and never a byte[] or
    a Key object on the heap.
